$comment: Corpus smoke job (docs/contributing/tests.md, 'Corpus smoke job'). One vendor-published spec per entry, pinned to a commit SHA and fetched at run time from raw.githubusercontent.com/<repo>/<sha>/<path>. Bumping a sha is a deliberate change. `known-failure` (issue link) marks an entry expected to fail: its failure does not fail the run, an unexpected pass is reported.

specs.name: kubernetes
specs.why: Largest Swagger 2.0 spec in the wild: thousands of definitions, deep $ref chains, x-kubernetes-* extensions, int-or-string types

specs.name: docker-engine
specs.why: Swagger 2.0; the docker-api fixture is an older version of this spec, this one measures drift

specs.name: slack
specs.why: Swagger 2.0; hundreds of near-identical ok/error response schemas, odd formats

specs.name: netlify
specs.why: Swagger 2.0; small, hand-written and maintained: the control entry

specs.name: github
specs.why: OpenAPI 3.0.3; the github manifest fixture commits no expected/ tree, so this is where its output gets analysed

specs.name: github-dereferenced
specs.why: OpenAPI 3.0.3; the same API with zero $refs: giant inline schemas, a different resolution path

specs.name: stripe
specs.why: OpenAPI 3.0; keys in alphabetical order (components before openapi), expandable objects via anyOf, x-expansionResources

specs.name: plaid
specs.why: OpenAPI 3.0.0; dense nullable + enum + allOf usage in one large file

specs.name: box
specs.why: OpenAPI 3.0.2; allOf inheritance chains with discriminators (File--Mini, File, File--Full)

specs.name: twilio-api
specs.why: OpenAPI 3.0; the largest of ~80 machine-generated Twilio specs

specs.name: twilio-messaging
specs.why: OpenAPI 3.0; a small Twilio spec from the same generator

specs.name: kubernetes-v3
specs.why: OpenAPI 3.0; the same API as the kubernetes entry through the other component

specs.name: github-next
specs.why: OpenAPI 3.1.0; the same API as the github entry in 3.1, isolating 3.1 handling from spec content

specs.name: discord
specs.why: OpenAPI 3.1.0; type arrays with null, const, oneOf + discriminator everywhere

specs.name: openai
specs.why: OpenAPI 3.1.0; anyOf/oneOf-heavy request bodies, text/event-stream and binary responses

specs.name: cloudflare
specs.why: Enormous allOf composition, more than 10 MB
